Hande Abeş and Aqza Elsa John, both PhD students in the group, attended the
NextGenBioCat meeting in Munich.

Hande works on bridging scales in the computational modeling of biochemical and
biocatalytic processes; Aqza works on the computational modeling of electrostatic
confinement in biocatalysis.
